summary: Build board-ready cyber metrics, dashboards, and risk narratives in 5 days. Learn practical reporting methods and enroll today.
lede: Cybersecurity metrics and board reporting helps security managers connect control data with executive decisions about exposure, resilience, business impact, and risk appetite. This course shows you how to select meaningful measures, map them to business objectives, and present trends in concise dashboards and board-ready narratives. You will practise building reporting artefacts that remain useful when telemetry is fragmented, asset inventories are incomplete, and data maturity varies. The course also introduces risk quantification concepts, SIEM and SOAR telemetry, and the reporting discipline needed to communicate security posture without overwhelming decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with cyber risk, control evidence, or executive reporting and need to sharpen board-facing communication.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with cybersecurity fundamentals, risk concepts, and basic governance reporting. Prior exposure to security operations, audit, or enterprise risk management is helpful, and no programming is required for course completion. A laptop is recommended for dashboard and template exercises, and familiarity with Excel or a BI reporting tool will help you complete the practical labs more efficiently.
